rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 3AB and notes image limitations, but it overstates confidence in identifying a distinct compact ICM and TE details that are not clearly discernible on this low-contrast image.
Integrates age, DOR, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, lifestyle, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis; only minor overinterpretation of AMH/DOR context.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with embryo quality balanced against uterine and patient factors; slight issue in calling AMH 2.3 as confirming DOR and in strongly quantifying the lining effect without full nuance.

Mostly consistent with Gardner grading and general IVF principles, but it overemphasizes endometrial thickness as a near-determinative barrier and makes somewhat overstated evidence claims about miscarriage workup and DOR implications.
The visible portion provides risk assessment but few concrete management steps for proceeding with transfer versus freeze-all, endometrial optimization, or future cycle planning.
